title: No settings for the calendar pop up on some clocks widgets
line: Fuzzy Clock now has a Calendar settings page to choose the first day of the week and show week numbers in its popup calendar.
explanation: Fuzzy Clock's popup is a bare calendar month view, and the widget had no settings for it: its configuration had only an Appearance page, so the week always started on the locale's default day and week numbers could never be shown, unlike in Digital Clock. The change adds showWeekNumbers and firstDayOfWeek entries, a Calendar settings page with the same two controls Digital Clock has, and binds them on the popup's month view.

commits.message:
applets/fuzzy-clock: add calendar settings

The calendar popup of the Fuzzy Clock always started the week on the
locale's default day and could not show week numbers, unlike Digital
Clock's. Add a Calendar settings page with both options and apply them.

BUG: 486129

patches.diff:
From a471f5b220a07597cc02a74a60979fd850db62ff Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 03:04:55 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/fuzzy-clock: add calendar settings

The calendar popup of the Fuzzy Clock always started the week on the
locale's default day and could not show week numbers, unlike Digital
Clock's. Add a Calendar settings page with both options and apply them.

BUG: 486129
---
 applets/fuzzy-clock/CMakeLists.txt         |  1 +
 applets/fuzzy-clock/main.xml               |  8 +++++
 applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/config.qml         |  5 +++
 applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/configCalendar.qml | 41 ++++++++++++++++++++++
 applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/main.qml           |  4 +++
 5 files changed, 59 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/configCalendar.qml

diff --git a/applets/fuzzy-clock/CMakeLists.txt b/applets/fuzzy-clock/CMakeLists.txt
index 43f8b7457..d712fd759 100644
--- a/applets/fuzzy-clock/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/applets/fuzzy-clock/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -4,6 +4,7 @@
 plasma_add_applet(org.kde.plasma.fuzzyclock
     QML_SOURCES
         qml/configAppearance.qml
+        qml/configCalendar.qml
         qml/config.qml
         qml/FuzzyClock.qml
         qml/main.qml
diff --git a/applets/fuzzy-clock/main.xml b/applets/fuzzy-clock/main.xml
index 6cb3d0c7d..8a78a5054 100644
--- a/applets/fuzzy-clock/main.xml
+++ b/applets/fuzzy-clock/main.xml
@@ -16,5 +16,13 @@
         <default>false</default>
     </entry>
   </group>
+  <group name="Calendar">
+    <entry name="showWeekNumbers" type="Bool">
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
+    <entry name="firstDayOfWeek" type="Int">
+      <default>-1</default>
+    </entry>
+  </group>
 
 </kcfg>
\ No newline at end of file
diff --git a/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/config.qml b/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/config.qml
index c5bb4a2a9..ed1f60135 100644
--- a/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/config.qml
+++ b/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/config.qml
@@ -14,4 +14,9 @@ ConfigModel {
          icon: "preferences-desktop-color"
          source: "configAppearance.qml"
     }
+    ConfigCategory {
+         name: i18nc("@title", "Calendar")
+         icon: "office-calendar"
+         source: "configCalendar.qml"
+    }
 }
diff --git a/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/configCalendar.qml b/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/configCalendar.qml
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..4b0a6a9e0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/configCalendar.qml
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+/*
+ * SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2015 Martin Klapetek <mklapetek@kde.org>
+ *
+ * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-GPL
+ */
+
+import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
+import QtQuick.Layouts
+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+import org.kde.kcmutils as KCM
+
+KCM.SimpleKCM {
+    id: calendarPage
+
+    property alias cfg_showWeekNumbers: showWeekNumbers.checked
+    property int cfg_firstDayOfWeek
+
+    Kirigami.FormLayout {
+        QQC2.CheckBox {
+            id: showWeekNumbers
+            Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@option:check formdata label", "General:")
+            text: i18nc("@option:check", "Show week numbers")
+        }
+
+        QQC2.ComboBox {
+            Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@label:listbox", "First day of week:")
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+
+            textRole: "text"
+            model: [-1, 0, 1, 5, 6].map(day => ({
+                day,
+                text: day === -1 ? i18nc("@item:inlistbox first day of week option", "Use region defaults") : Qt.locale().dayName(day),
+            }))
+            onActivated: index => {
+                calendarPage.cfg_firstDayOfWeek = model[index].day;
+            }
+            currentIndex: model.findIndex(item => item.day === calendarPage.cfg_firstDayOfWeek)
+        }
+    }
+}
diff --git a/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/main.qml b/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/main.qml
index 45e41a6be..14ee119cc 100644
--- a/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/main.qml
@@ -54,5 +54,9 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         Kirigami.Theme.colorSet: Kirigami.Theme.Window
 
         today: root.currentDateTime
+        firstDayOfWeek: Plasmoid.configuration.firstDayOfWeek > -1
+            ? Plasmoid.configuration.firstDayOfWeek
+            : Qt.locale().firstDayOfWeek
+        showWeekNumbers: Plasmoid.configuration.showWeekNumbers
     }
 }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Fuzzy Clock settings on master: only Appearance, no calendar options
New Calendar page with week numbers and first day of week (set to Monday)
Popup calendar on master: always the locale's week, no week numbers
Popup after the change: week starts on Monday with week numbers

review.text: This is the minimal fix the bug asked for. It adds two config entries, a Calendar page that mirrors Digital Clock's first-day and week-number controls, and binds them on the existing MonthView. Leaving out the holiday plugins is right, since the popup has no agenda to show them. The screenshots show the new page and the popup starting on Monday with week numbers. The config page is a copy of Digital Clock's. That's acceptable across repos, but the SPDX header should also credit the new author, and a reviewer may ask for a shared component later.
